title: Revival of jazz and Gulf Coast bands
summary: Kerrigan was in Texas for five years and leaves the revival to others; he describes the 1947 reorganised club using Gulf Coast bands such as Merritt Brunies's in Biloxi and a retired-musicians five-piece band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
